newsitem.title: UK: Shell Expro revises Dec Brent programme down one.
newsitem.headline: Shell Expro revises Dec Brent programme down one.

text.p: Shell Expro, operator of the North Sea Brent crude system, told equity producers it was revising down by one cargo to 43 the number of standard 500,000-barrel shipments to be loaded in December, traders said.
In a telex to Brent partners on Thursday, Shell Expro said the December Brent programme sent out early on Thursday wrongly said there would be 44 500,000-barrel cargoes.
As a result, the revised December programme schedules 43 500,000-barrel cargoes and 2.849 million barrels in top-ups.
"Shell said it wrongly said one cargo would load 500,000 barrels when it really will load just 100,000 barrels," a trader said.

The November Brent programme was also revised several times. Originally, the programme was scheduled to load 38 standard cargoes and 2.17 million barrels in top-ups but three November cargoes were deferred into December on Wednesday.
The deferrals came just two days after Shell added a cargo to the November programme after it had omitted it by mistake when the programme was first released in mid-October.
